policy_updates: Never trust marketplace-open status without verifying the primary GitHub issue or PR.
A bounty label is not evidence of funded reward; verify the payment/reward record or authoritative bot comment.
Reject work whose verified reward is economically disproportionate to the acceptance scope.
Do not manufacture EXECUTE activity when no candidate passes VERIFY; SELECT_NONE is a valid terminal outcome.
Prefer escrowed or otherwise externally verifiable funding over creator-promised post-merge payment when candidates are otherwise comparable.

priority: fresh primary-source GitHub issues with verified funded reward
